title: The GenAI4IDN Benchmark 3.0 - a Public Tool to Assess Generative AI Tools for the Design of Interactive Digital Narratives
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark for evaluating generative AI tools in the context of interactive digital narratives. While it explicitly includes a framework to assess social bias (measuring fairness, representation, and sensitivity), it does not evaluate or benchmark ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, or religious/theological concepts.
